description: Get XBRL data from US public companies and utilities by searching on facts, reports, entities, and tables or statements (cubes). Explore concepts, labels, references, roles, arcs, cubes, and assertions to understand structure. Quickly pinpoint financial data and relationships for analysis, compliance, and auditing. Streamline investment research and compliance checks with structured business information.
